name: tattvam-inbound
description: Inbound carrier calls -> per-call room tattvam-<caller> + dispatch my-agent. Room name is the call-correlation id (SIP Call-ID -> room -> job).
notes: Create via LiveKit Cloud dashboard -> SIP -> Dispatch Rules, or via API with this payload.
Pair with an inbound trunk: Twilio trial number, auth by IP/creds, codec forced to G.711 mu-law.
Each caller gets its own room + isolated agent session; concurrent callers do NOT share state.
Outbound trunk (same provider) is required later for SIP REFER transfer to +91 80500 53808.
